title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to own the transformation and modeling layer of DDN’s enterprise data platform. You’ll turn raw data from Salesforce, Workday, product systems, and other sources into trusted, well-documented datasets that stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Product, and Operations actually use to make decisions. You’ll work closely with data engineers who manage ingestion and infrastructure, and with analysts and business partners who consume what you build.

What You’ll Own


Data modeling — design, build, and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into clean, reliable datasets for analytics and reporting
Data quality — implement and maintain testing, monitoring, and documentation so stakeholders can trust what they’re looking at
BI & semantic layer — build and maintain Sigma data models and workbooks that give business users self-serve access to data
Collaboration — partner with business stakeholders to understand their analytical needs and translate them into scalable, maintainable data models; work with data engineers on source data requirements


Your Experience Includes


5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar data-focused role
Expert-level SQL including experience with complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning
Strong experience with dbt for building and maintaining transformation pipelines
Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar)
Understanding of dimensional modeling and data warehouse design patterns
Experience building and maintaining BI content (dashboards, data models, semantic layers) in tools like Sigma, Looker, or similar
Strong Python skills for data analysis, automation, or pipeline work
Solid understanding of data quality practices including testing, monitoring, documentation
Strong communication skills and demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have


Experience with Sigma Computing specifically
Familiarity with data quality frameworks (e.g., Elementary, Great Expectations)
Familiarity with data governance practices — PII handling, access controls, documentation standards
Experience with version-controlled, CI/CD-driven analytics workflows
Prior experience in a small data team where you wore multiple hats


Compensation Range: $150K - $185K

title: Senior AI Data & Analytics Engineer II
description:
Who We Are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross-functional automation.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:



You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.



In this role, you will:



Partner on defining the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation.
Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics.
Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well-modeled data.
Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning.
Lead complex, cross-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships.
Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts.
Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: build AI-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy.
Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps.
Ship high-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI-generated work before it reaches production.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.



Minimum requirements for the role:



8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands-on data engineering experience.
Expert-level Python and SQL, with strong hands-on data modeling and DBT experience.
Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).
Experience building semantic layers and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows.
Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output.
Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production.
Track record of leading complex, cross-team data initiatives, including independent requirements gathering with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, or Product teams.



An ideal candidate also has:



Experience working with Databricks and building AI Agents within the ecosystem.
Software engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well-architected, delivered solutions.
Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs.
Familiarity with go-to-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools.
Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks.
Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience.
Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies.

description:
Job Description

Morgan Health is a mission-driven healthcare organization within JPMorgan Chase focused on improving the quality, affordability, and experience of employer-sponsored healthcare. We operate with the focus and agility of a smaller, specialized team, backed by the scale, resources, and reach of one of the world's largest companies. Our team brings together healthcare, data, research, investment, and policy expertise to tackle some of the most complex challenges facing employers and their employees. If you are someone who wants their technical work to have a tangible impact on healthcare, this is a unique opportunity to build within a highly collaborative team to further Morgan Health's mission.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer within Morgan Health, you'll play a key role in building the data foundation behind that work. You'll have meaningful ownership of Morgan Health's analytics environment, partnering closely with data scientists as well as other internal and external stakeholders to turn complex healthcare data into trusted, production-ready data marts that support research, insights, and decision-making. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape how analytics engineering is done within Morgan Health — not simply inherit an established process. You will own and evolve core elements of the analytics life cycle, from data modeling and testing to CI/CD, monitoring and quality standards. Because we're a focused team, you will work closely with the people using the data and have visibility into how your work contributes to healthcare research, insights, and ultimately better outcomes.

This role is in-office five days per week, based in either New York, NY or Washington, DC.

Job Responsibilities


Develop and maintain Morgan Health's healthcare data models (e.g., marts and curated datasets) using SQL and dbt
Create proof of concept (POC) solutions of data products per data scientist design requirements; iterate rapidly to refine requirements and evolve POCs to production-level solutions
Design and evolve a robust automated testing framework (e.g., dbt tests, custom checks, risk-based testing strategies)

Hands-on experience using Databricks (or similar platforms) to develop, deploy, and support data pipelines and analytics workflows in a production environment; experience working with Python or R for analysis, testing, and automation
Proven track record of creating and maintaining data models, data marts, and transformations that support multiple competing analytical use cases
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to effectively interface within cross-functional teams (data scientists, analytics engineering, product/architecture, and platform partners)


Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools to develop, test, and improve SQL, Python, and analytics engineering workflows

Demonstrated ability to successfully multitask, balance competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment

title: Senior AI Data Analyst
description:
About AirOps

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

As our Senior AI Analyst, you’ll build trusted data models, drive business decisions, and help customers measure the value AirOps delivers. You’ll report to our Analytics Lead as a hands-on individual contributor, using AI to accelerate work across all three areas. Priorities will evolve as AirOps continues to scale to $100M and beyond, with potential to take on team leadership as the analytics function grows.

What you’ll do


Expand our current AI data stack by designing and building reliable data models that turn raw data into trusted analytical datasets.
Own metric definitions and data quality — keep models tested, documented, and consistent across dashboards and AI tooling.
Leverage AI to lead deep-dive analyses across Product, Finance, and GTM teams to identify opportunities and provide clear recommendations on ways to optimize the business.
Build dashboards and compelling visualizations to help communicate findings to C-level and VP-level leaders.
Partner with our CX team to present insights and actionable recommendations directly to customers, connecting their GA4, GSC, and AI Search data to business outcomes.
Turn recurring internal and customer questions into reusable models, self-service resources, and reporting frameworks that scale.


Who you are


5+ years in analytics or analytics engineering, including experience at rapidly growing startups.
Strong SQL skills — you’ve built data models from scratch, understand table relationships, grain, and cloud data warehouses, and can independently explain and debug your logic.
AI-native — you use tools like Claude Code and Codex to accelerate modeling and analysis, and validate outputs against source data and business definitions.
Highly analytical — you use cohort, funnel, and segmentation analysis to uncover insights and distinguish meaningful changes from noise.
Strong communicator — you tell compelling data stories and make complex findings clear to executives, customers, and technical peers.
Thrive in ambiguity — you clarify open-ended questions, prioritize by business impact, and adapt quickly when needs change.
Hands-on owner — you drive work from raw data to recommendations and follow through across technical, business, and customer contexts.
Quality-minded — you move fast, validate results, communicate uncertainty, and handle customer and business data responsibly.


Nice to have


Customer-facing analytics experience — you’ve led discussions and presented findings directly to customers.
Experience with GA4 and Google Search Console, including search, traffic, and conversion analysis.
Familiarity with Metabase, dbt, semantic layers (Cube), and analytics delivered through MCP-connected AI tools.
Experience with AI search measurement, brand visibility, mention rates, and citation analysis.
Python proficiency for analysis, data validation, scripting, or automation.


Our Guiding Principles

We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. This is a hybrid role. Office attendance is required at least twice a week on Tuesdays and Thursdays for collaboration and connection. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.

About The Role

As a Staff Product Analytics Data Scientist, you will be the analytical backbone of how Ironclad understands, measures, and improves its product. You'll turn raw product usage and contract data into a deep, quantitative understanding of how customers adopt our platform and our AI and you'll translate that understanding into decisions that shape the roadmap.

This is a builder's role. Our team owns its own data end to end: we model and maintain our own dbt pipelines, mine large and messy datasets for signal, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to ship data products that put insight directly into customers' and teammates' hands. You'll wear a product analytics hat most days, an analytics engineering hat when the pipeline needs it, and a data science hat when a problem calls for experimentation, causal inference, or modeling. As a Staff-level individual contributor, you'll set analytical direction, raise the technical bar across the team, and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

What You'll Do


Own product understanding. Define, instrument, and analyze the metrics that describe how customers adopt, retain, and get value from Ironclad—funnels, activation, feature adoption (including our AI features like Jurist), engagement, and retention—and make them trustworthy and self-serve.
Drive experimentation and causal analysis. Design and analyze A/B tests and quasi-experiments; apply causal inference where clean experiments aren't possible; and give Product and Engineering clear, defensible reads on what actually moved the needle.
Mine data for opportunity. Explore large, complex product and contract datasets to surface non-obvious patterns, quantify opportunities, and generate hypotheses that shape strategy—not just answer questions that were already asked.
Build and evolve data products. Partner with Product and Engineering to turn analysis into shipped features—embedded analytics, benchmarks, insights, and AI-powered experiences—that deliver value directly to customers and internal teams.
Wear the analytics engineering hat. Own and extend the dbt models and transformations that power your work. Because our team owns its pipelines, you'll design scalable, well-documented, well-tested data models and uphold consistent definitions across the warehouse and BI layer.
Architect AI-ready data. Leverage AI to accelerate your own pipeline and analysis work, and structure our data assets, documentation, and metadata so that both humans and LLMs can navigate them with high confidence and minimal hallucination.
Set the bar and mentor. Provide technical direction, code and analysis reviews, and mentorship to analysts, data scientists, and analytics engineers—fostering a culture of rigor, collaboration, and impact.
Influence senior stakeholders. Bring clarity to ambiguous, high-stakes product questions and communicate findings in a way that drives alignment and action across Product, Engineering, and leadership.
Self-serve enablement: Design and scale self-serve analytics ecosystems, semantic layers, and clear data documentation that empower non-technical stakeholders to answer their own data questions with confidence.


What We're Looking For


8+ years of experience in product analytics, data science, or a closely related quantitative field, including demonstrated impact at a senior or staff level (ideally at a B2B SaaS company).
Deep expertise in product analytics: experimentation and A/B testing, funnel and retention analysis, causal inference, and defining product metrics that stand up to scrutiny.
Advanced SQL, plus fluency in Python or R for analysis, statistics, and modeling.
You can own dbt models, data modeling, and ELT best practices, and you're comfortable being the person who fixes the pipeline rather than filing a ticket.
A track record of partnering with Product and Engineering to ship data products or data-informed features, not just deliver dashboards and reports.
Strong data mining and exploratory instincts: you find the signal in large, messy datasets and know which findings are worth acting on.
Experience (or strong interest) in AI-assisted development and "AI-ready" data—using tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and writing documentation and metadata that help humans and LLMs work with data reliably.
Familiarity with a modern data stack such as Segment, Fivetran, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, Looker, and exploration tools like Hex (or their equivalents).
A self-starter who leads initiatives end to end, communicates with clarity, and bridges technical work and business impact.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

Data, analytics and AI are critical enablers of AXIS' strategic ambitions. The Insights & Analytics Lead – North America will be a hands-on technical leader who turns business questions into high-quality insights, analytical solutions and clear recommendations for North American underwriting teams.

This role is responsible for translating business requirements into well-defined data, analytics, data science and AI requirements. You will explore and analyse large and complex data sets, identify trends and opportunities, determine the most appropriate analytical approach, and communicate conclusions in ways that support better, faster and more informed decisions.

Working within an agile delivery model, you will partner closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects and Technology experts to design, test and deliver solutions that are practical, scalable and aligned to measurable business outcomes.

Reporting to the Insights & Analytics Director – North America, you will combine technical depth, business understanding and strong delivery skills. You will provide day-to-day technical leadership on initiatives while remaining personally involved in analysis, solution design and the development of analytical outputs.

What will you do in this role?


Translate Business Needs into Analytical and AI Requirements Partner with North American underwriting and business teams to understand business objectives, decision points, pain points and opportunities.
Translate business requirements into clear data, analytics, data science and AI requirements, including hypotheses, data needs, analytical methods, success measures and delivery acceptance criteria.
Challenge and refine requests to ensure the proposed solution addresses the underlying business problem and is proportionate to the value and complexity involved.
Recommend the right approach for each problem, whether descriptive or diagnostic analysis, reporting and visualisation, predictive modelling, machine learning, generative AI or workflow automation.
Deliver Hands-On Analysis and Insight
Frame analytical questions, develop hypotheses, select appropriate methods and validate findings before drawing conclusions.
Convert analysis into practical recommendations, explaining the business implications, limitations and actions required.
Identify opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities could improve underwriting effectiveness, portfolio management, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
Shape solution concepts and technical requirements, including use cases, user journeys, required data, model or AI behaviour, controls, evaluation criteria and expected business value.
Rapidly prototype analytical and AI-enabled solutions to test feasibility and value before wider development.
Work with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to support model development, testing, validation, deployment and ongoing performance monitoring.
Ensure solutions are explainable, fit-for-purpose and developed in line with AXIS data, AI governance, security and responsible AI requirements.
Work as an active member of cross-functional agile delivery teams, partnering closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Technology experts and business product owners.
Contribute technical analysis, solution design, backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demonstrations, testing and retrospectives.
Promote reuse of common data products, analytical methods, models and components across the wider Insights & Analytics community.
Define and track outcome-focused success measures, using feedback and performance evidence to improve solutions after release.
Explain analytical and AI concepts in clear business language and build confidence in the appropriate use of data-driven insights.

Success in this role will be measured through:


Delivered solutions contribute to measurable improvements in underwriting effectiveness, portfolio insight, operational efficiency or customer outcomes.
Solutions use the right level of analytical sophistication for the problem and are practical, explainable and fit-for-purpose.
Strong collaboration and trusted working relationships are established across North America business teams, Data & Analytics and Technology.
Insights and solutions are adopted and used within day-to-day business decisions and workflows.
Analytical assets, methods and components are documented, reusable and continuously improved.



About you:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might help you fulfil this role and contribute to our goals.

What you need to have:

Experience


A minimum of 7 years’ experience in analytics, business intelligence, data science or AI roles, with substantial hands-on experience analysing complex data and delivering data-driven solutions.
A minimum of 3 years’ experience in the insurance or reinsurance industry, ideally partnering with underwriting, portfolio management or specialty insurance business functions.

A strong problem solver who combines technical depth with commercial judgement and a focus on practical business outcomes.
Clear and credible communicator who can present complex findings simply and adapt the message for technical and business audiences.

title: Inventory Planning & Data Analyst
description:
Our Story

With over 50 years of serving the creative community, Adorama has grown from a beloved New York City camera store into the world’s only full-service destination for photo, video, and electronics. At Adorama, we don’t just support creativity—we live it. Join a team that’s shaping the future of how the world captures, creates and connects.

Our Leadership Principles


Growth Mindset: We set high standards, embrace failure, and are open to change.

Take Ownership & Dig Deeper: We are proactive, use data, and avoid shortcuts.
Think Like a Start-Up: We move fast, stay flexible, and celebrate every win.
Be Humble & Respectful: We assume positive intent, listen actively, and support one another.


What You'll Do

The Inventory Planning & Data Analyst will combine hands-on inventory planning, SQL, business intelligence, and reporting automation to improve product availability, strengthen purchasing decisions, and optimize inventory investment.

Reporting to the Head of Inventory and Demand Planning and working directly with Merchants, you will investigate inventory, demand, and supply issues, identify root causes, and turn findings into actionable SKU-level recommendations. You will independently build dashboards and analytical tools, own recurring analysis and replenishment reviews, and follow corrective actions through resolution within established planning policies and purchasing authority.

This role offers direct exposure to initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution, lead time, and excess inventory management, with opportunities to improve how the team uses data and reduce recurring manual work.

Responsibilities:


Merchant Support and Inventory Decisions
Apply established inventory, weeks of supply (WOS), and aged inventory targets correctly when reviewing PO recommendations and inventory health; flag exceptions, recommend corrective actions, and follow through with Merchants.
Investigate merchant questions, identify root causes, and provide clear item-level recommendations; track agreed actions and escalate unresolved issues.


Replenishment and PO Execution
Review daily replenishment and PO needs against established inventory and WOS targets, run-rate, lead time, available inventory, open POs, backorders, and demand trends to control purchasing and avoid excess inventory.
Validate system recommendations before execution, especially for high-velocity, high-value, long-lead-time items and SKUs with demand spikes or overstock risk.
Release purchase orders within approved authority and follow up with vendors on past-due POs, delivery changes, and supply constraints.
Monitor backorders and stockout risk; escalate issues affecting availability, inventory exposure, or merchant goals and track corrective actions through resolution.


BI Dashboards and Planning Analytics
Independently build, maintain, and enhance inventory and planning dashboards in Looker, including data preparation, calculated metrics, filters, and reporting validation.
Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and validate sales, demand, inventory, item master, and PO data.
Monitor dashboard refreshes and reporting accuracy; reconcile outputs with source data and troubleshoot discrepancies with BI and technical partners.
Automate recurring reporting and build exception dashboards that prioritize stockout risk, aged inventory, overstock, backorders, past-due POs, demand anomalies, and data gaps; highlight affected SKUs, investigation priorities, recommended actions, and follow-up owners.
Maintain reporting that monitors inventory, WOS, and aged inventory against established targets; verify their correct application in replenishment and PO review, investigate variances, and recommend corrective actions for approval.
Support approved initiatives in forecast optimization, warehouse distribution and transfers, slow-moving and excess inventory reporting, and lead time and customer ETA reporting through data validation, analysis, and follow-up.


Root Cause Analysis and Planning Data Accuracy
Work with Merchants and Item Master to keep planning-related item fields accurate and updated promptly; identify missing, outdated, or incorrect attributes affecting replenishment and reporting.
Follow up on item setup and planning feed issues that create inaccurate recommendations, reporting gaps, or poor inventory decisions.
Investigate flagged exceptions involving aged inventory, overstock, past-due POs, backorders, planning overrides, unusual demand, and data gaps to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
Perform root-cause analysis to identify demand shifts, vendor delays, lead time changes, PO timing issues, item setup errors, or execution gaps; recommend practical corrective actions.
Account for promotions, one-time sales spikes, new items, vendor transitions, and opportunity buys when evaluating planning recommendations.


Cross-Functional Collaboration and Process Improvement
Partner with Merchants to validate demand changes, product lifecycle status, vendor realities, and purchasing needs; respond to requests with data-backed recommendations.
Coordinate with Vendors, Item Master, Warehouse Operations, Finance, and BI to resolve inventory issues; own related JIRA tickets from intake through closure.
Maintain a structured daily replenishment and exception review, weekly merchant action follow-up, and recurring KPI reporting cadence.
Document and maintain established workflows and reporting definitions; recommend improvements to replenishment execution, data quality, and merchant follow-up for approval by the Head of Inventory and Demand Planning.

Required Skills and Experience


At least 3 years of relevant experience in inventory planning, replenishment, demand planning, or supply chain analytics, including hands-on inventory analysis and business reporting.
Demonstrated experience independently building and maintaining operational dashboards and automating recurring reporting in Looker, Tableau, or Power BI, including data preparation, metric definitions and calculations, refresh configuration, validation, and troubleshooting. Candidates must demonstrate their own contributions and resulting business impact.
Very strong Excel skills, including Power Query, PivotTables, XLOOKUP and other lookup functions, advanced formulas, data reconciliation, and analysis of large SKU-level datasets.
Hands-on SQL proficiency, with the ability to write, validate, and troubleshoot queries independently using joins, aggregations, and CTEs, as well as identify duplicate records, missing data, and discrepancies across sources.
Strong understanding of weeks of supply, run-rate, lead time, inventory turns, GMROI, aged inventory, overstock, backorders, and open PO management.
Strong attention to detail, root-cause analysis, organization, and communication; able to explain findings clearly and follow issues through resolution.


Preferred Skills and Experience


Knowledge of Python and Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) for analysis, reporting automation, and maintenance of existing scripts or Excel tools.
Experience with BigQuery, ERP or replenishment systems, JIRA, or automated planning workflows.
E-commerce, retail, consumer electronics, or marketplace inventory experience.


Success Measures

Effective merchant support with actionable recommendations and consistent follow-through; adherence to established inventory, WOS, and aged inventory targets; faster root-cause identification and resolution of inventory and data issues; timely, actionable exception reporting; accurate and reliable dashboards; timely and accurate replenishment and PO execution; and measurable reductions in recurring manual work.

This role requires three on-site days weekly to ensure in-person collaboration, improved communication, effective teamwork, and real-time problem solving to enhance team synergy and productivity. A standard 40-hour work week is expected.

Pay range for this role:: $75,000 USD - $85,000 USD

Demonstrated understanding of data quality concepts, with ability to execute data preparation, validation, and reconciliation processes with strong diagnostic rigor, including identifying data anomalies and discrepancies, applying validation rules, and ensuring accuracy of reporting outputs.

Integrity & Trust
Customer Focus

Senior Quality Engineer

Imperial Brady is building a single enterprise data platform out of the merged Imperial Dade and BradyPlus data estates. The EDW team delivers that platform on Microsoft Fabric, and every change we ship moves through Dev, UAT, and Prod on a three-week sprint cycle.

We are hiring our first dedicated Quality Engineer, at a senior level. This is an engineering role. The person in this seat writes and runs automated tests that prove our pipelines, transformations, and architecture changes behave correctly before anything is handed to the business. Their work happens during the development weeks, inside the code and the deployment pipeline, not at the end of the sprint.

To be explicit about the boundary: this role is not UAT testing, and it is not data quality validation. The business units own data quality and acceptance during the UAT week, and they produce the reconciliation evidence that gates a release. This role exists so that by the time a Story reaches UAT, the business is evaluating whether the numbers are right, not discovering that the build is broken. There is no test framework, no automated regression suite, and no QA function today. You are being hired to build them.

Compensation Range: $120,000 to $140,000 + Bonus

Salary range reflects the Jersey City, NJ market & compensation may vary based on geographic location

You Will


Build automated tests that exercise Fabric pipelines, notebooks, and transformation logic, proving that a pipeline runs end to end, handles failure and retry correctly, and produces the expected result from controlled test input.
Build automated checks that validate structural changes to materialized lake views (MLVs), lakehouse tables, and semantic models: expected columns and data types, key definitions, dependency chains, and view refresh behavior after a change.
Test the incremental load behavior our pipelines depend on: watermarking, idempotency, restart and rerun safety, late arriving records, and full reload versus delta paths.
Automate environment parity verification across Dev, UAT, and Prod, covering object inventory, schema, configuration, and dependency structure, and report drift as soon as it appears rather than at reconciliation time.
Act as the technical authority on testing for the team. Mentor developers on writing their own tests and set the direction the function follows as it grows beyond one person.
Help stand up the testing and deployment practice against the Fabric Well-Architected Framework, which the team is adopting as its governance baseline. Much of that alignment is still ahead of us and this role contributes to defining it.
Report on engineering quality with real numbers: automated coverage, test pass rate, build failure rate, and defect escape rate by stage.


You Have


Five or more years in test automation, software engineering in test, or data engineering with a heavy testing component, including time spent building a test framework rather than only working inside one. Manual QA experience alone is not a fit for this role.
Strong Python, including building and maintaining real test suites with a framework such as pytest, and comfort working in PySpark or notebook-based data processing.
Strong SQL, at the level of writing the query that proves a transformation produced what the specification called for.
Demonstrated experience testing ETL or ELT pipelines and dimensional models, with a working understanding of fact and dimension tables, grain, incremental loads, and slowly changing dimensions.
Practical Git and CI/CD experience: branching, pull requests, and building automated checks that run inside a deployment pipeline.
Experience defining and enforcing technical acceptance criteria as part of an Agile sprint process, including holding a release gate when a change is not ready.
Clear written communication, since a large part of this role is documenting what is covered by automation and what is not.

title: Machine Learning Engineer II
description:
Kensho is S&P Global’s hub for AI innovation and transformation. With expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at S&P Global and its customers worldwide. Kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative AI applications, agents, data retrieval APIs, data extraction, and much more.

At Kensho, we hire talented people and give them the autonomy and support needed to build amazing technology and products. We collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. Our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. We dedicate time and resources to explore new ideas, but always rooted in engineering best practices. As a result, we can innovate rapidly to produce technology that is scalable, robust, and useful.

The DRIVE Team at Kensho is focused on designing and deploying production-grade machine learning systems that power our next-generation agentic search pipelines. We specialize in building robust retrieval systems, scalable embedding infrastructure, and tightly integrated LLM pipelines that leverage unstructured data sources.

Our mission is to make complex unstructured data easily discoverable and actionable by building intelligent, retrieval-driven systems that enhance enterprise search, question answering, deep research, report generation, and knowledge discovery experiences across S&P Global platforms.

We are seeking a mid-level Machine Learning Engineer to help develop and scale RAG systems across the company. This is a hands-on, full-lifecycle ML role with a strong emphasis on retrieval models, LLM orchestration, and system-level thinking.

Kensho states that the anticipated base salary range for the position is 140k - 180k. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and equity plans. At Kensho, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

What You’ll Do


Design and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines that integrate proprietary chunking algorithms, embedding models, vector databases, and data retrieval agents
Build and optimize retrieval systems over large-scale proprietary datasets using advanced embedding techniques
Develop LLM-based solutions that orchestrate retrieval, generation, and ranking to deliver high-quality, context-aware responses
Investigate and solve challenges in vector search, chunking and indexing strategies, unstructured data retrieval evaluation, and GraphRAG
Work closely with Product and Design teams to build ML-based solutions that enhance user experiences and meet business objectives
Collaborate closely with the ML Operations team to create automated solutions for managing the entire ML systems lifecycle, from initial technical design to seamless implementation


Who You'll Need


Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of significant, hands-on industry experience with machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), information retrieval systems and large-scale text processing, including designing, shipping, and maintaining production systems
Strong programming skills in Python, with a working knowledge of data processing tools and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, Transformers, and HuggingFace
Experience working with machine learning libraries/frameworks for Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, such as Langchain, LLamaIndex, etc.
Proven experience building ML pipelines for data processing, training, inference, maintenance, evaluation, versioning, and experimentation.
Experience working with vector databases (e.g., PostgreSQL/PGVector, OpenSearch, Pinecone) and understanding of similarity search techniques and vector indexing algorithms
Demonstrated effective coding, documentation, collaboration, and communication habits
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges
Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment


Technologies We Love


ML: PyTorch, Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain
Tools/Toolkits: Claude Code, Weights & Biases, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL/PGVector, LiteLLM
Techniques: Agentic Search, Prompt Engineering, Information Retrieval, Data Embedding, AI agent evaluation
Deployment: Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, AWS, Github Action

100% company paid premiums

Bike sharing program memberships
